scope: IPv4 inner/outer; 200 ICMP 56-byte probes at 20ms, idle and paced TCP bidir P1 100M per direction; not saturated latency or one-way delay
percentile_method: nearest-rank per window; median/min/max across three fresh sessions; lost probes have no fabricated RTT
limits: No one-way, saturated, P4, IPv6, UDP payload bidir or auth-rate claims
No latency regression threshold or universal performance PASS
Only successful replies form RTT population; loss retained separately
p99 per window is the 198th ordered value of 200 replies, not a long-duration tail guarantee
